name: MH02a2: Known Depression and/or Anxiety
description:
Number of active ART clients documented as known mental-health cases involving depression and/or anxiety during the reporting quarter.
The patient's status must indicate known mental illness on psychotherapy, medication, both, or neither.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.anxiety_and_or_depression IN (
      'Known mental illness on Psychotherapy only',
      'Known mental illness on Medication only',
      'Known mental illness NEITHER on Psychotherapy NOR Medication',
      'Known mental illness on Psychotherapy and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
